Visa study: Digital remittances growing in Asia Pacific

A Visa study indicates that the adoption of digital remittances is accelerating across the Asia Pacific region. The report highlights trust as a critical factor enabling this growth. The study specifically notes the increasing use of digital channels for sending money across borders within the region.
